description.value:
A creature you can see within range is wrapped in flame and must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. A creature that fails also continues to burn for the duration, shedding bright light out to 30 feet and dim light 30 feet beyond that; at the end of each of its turns it repeats the save, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failure or extinguishing the flames on a success. Mundane means cannot put out this fire.

A creature slain by this power's damage is reduced to ash.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 5
